note: Quiet idle between minute changes; one action sequence per consecutive minute transition. No action on startup or time corrections.

name: Ice Climber - Summit Partners
description: Popo climbs through the ice shelf, pauses beside Nana, then returns. One climb on each minute change.
auditNote: FIXED: Popo jumps off the upper shelf into the gap, descends until his whole body clears the shelf, then walks home facing left. Nine shelf-intersection frames and unsupported return walking removed.

name: Donkey Kong - Barrel Girders
description: Kong releases a barrel across the girders. Mario jumps as it rolls past; the scene settles back to idle.
auditNote: Barrel release, upper travel, drop and lower return reviewed. Mario's opaque pixels clear the barrel and both girders throughout the jump.

name: Cobra Triangle - River Run
description: The Cobra boat runs upriver through diagonal banks, with a moving wake and water glints.
auditNote: Boat faces upstream, wake trails downstream and river textures move consistently. Shoreline behind the clock is intentional; the continuous loop joins cleanly.

name: Bubble Bobble - Bubble Trouble
description: Bub blows a bubble, traps Zen-Chan, jumps to pop it, and collects the fruit. Bob waits on the opposite ledge. One action at each minute change.
auditNote: Reviewed: blow, trap, first-contact pop, falling fruit, collection and return. Opaque actor/platform checks pass; Bob remains on his ledge. Included in Pack 2.
